exposure_label: Max DINO similarity to any Many class
descriptive_group_rule: Descriptive split only. Sort finite similarity by (max similarity, class ID) ascending. For 30 classes ranks 1–15 are lower and ranks 16–30 are upper.
interpretation_note: Exploratory class-level association. Bootstrap resamples the 30 Few classes conditional on seed 42. LOCO checks single-class influence within the same trained seed. Neither quantifies training-seed uncertainty, identifies a causal effect, or supplies independent replication. Delta accuracy contains the LC-only baseline with a negative sign, so baseline-adjusted and unadjusted results must be read together to assess mathematical-coupling/regression-to-mean sensitivity.
